messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Horizant (gabapentin enacarbil, extended-release tablet) | Not approved | Adults | Adults (moderate to severe primary RLS)
Sources: FDA prescribing information for Neurontin, Gralise, and Horizant; Relgaabi prescribing information (DailyMed)
Triplet: ["Horizant", "has source", "Relgaabi prescribing information (DailyMed)"]

The relation 'has source' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's information is sourced from the document or entity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'has note': The subject drug has an additional note or clarification provided that is specified by the object entity.
C. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
D. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
E. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
